judgment.label: incorrect
judgment.reason: Candidate says operating margin decreased by 1.7 pts (19.1% vs 20.8%) which matches evidence, but attributes decline primarily to raw material/logistics costs (2.4 pts) and litigation (1.4 pts) as separate drivers. Evidence and reference show margin drop driven by one-off special items (litigation, PFAS impairment, Russia exit, divestiture restructuring) and gross margin pressures; candidate's specific 1.4 and 2.4 pt splits and emphasis on raw material inflation as primary are not supported and conflict with reference's 'mostly one-off charges' cause.

checks.reason: Margin expressed in % points, consistent with question.
Margin change magnitude correct but drivers misstated vs evidence/reference; overweights raw material costs, invents point estimates not in evidence.
Evidence supports special item charges and cost of sales increase, not candidate's 1.4/2.4 pt litigation/raw material splits as primary drivers.
